environment.faultScope: loopback relay only; host adapters/firewall unchanged

limits: Passing instrumented variants do not prove an observer effect: provider delivery, startup and host timing also vary.
Native audio/picture counts and loopback energy do not establish provider source alignment or physical output latency.
Read/write times measure body I/O waits, include scheduling, and can sum overlapping requests. Header/connect waits are not included. Fault/seek cancellation can increment failures.
Full per-track trace is sampled before the gate decision; the original progress predicate still decides stability. A phase-3 trace row may lag the recovery event by one tick.
Thirty seconds is an observed recovery acceptance deadline; the process supervisor separately bounds blocking native calls.
